consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly praise the performance of the 1985-06-30 show, particularly highlighting the energy and quality of the second set. The standout song is 'Shakedown Street,' which many consider one of the best versions ever played, showcasing the band's tightness and improvisational skills.
